newsitem.title: TURKEY: Forest fire blazes near Turkish holiday resort.
newsitem.headline: Forest fire blazes near Turkish holiday resort.

text.p: Turkish fire services used aircraft to fight a forest blaze near a popular Mediterranean holiday resort in southwest Turkey on Tuesday, Anatolian news agency reported.
It said the fire covered an area of around a thousand hectares (2,500 acres) and was approaching two residential areas, several km (miles) from the resort of Marmaris.
Two airplanes and seven helicopters supported fire crews from across the region in fighting the blaze, which began on Monday afternoon.
The fire was close to the site of a blaze in July last year which destroyed around 1,500 hectares (3,700 acres) of woodlands.
